--[[
    TRI-MENU V6.1: 
    1. Air Walk (Vuelo por plataformas)
    2. Path Builder (Caminos Personalizados)
--]]

local Player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- --- CONFIGURACIÓN Y ESTADO ---
local Estado = {
    AirWalk = false,
    AlturaDeseada = 0,
    UltimaPlataforma = nil
}

-- Carpetas de almacenamiento
local function GetFolder(name)
    local f = workspace:FindFirstChild(name) or Instance.new("Folder", workspace)
    f.Name = name
    return f
end

local Folders = {
    AirWalk = GetFolder("Storage_AirWalk"),
    Path = GetFolder("Storage_Paths")
}

-- --- INTERFAZ PRINCIPAL ---
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", Player.PlayerGui)
ScreenGui.Name = "TriMenu_V6_Mod"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame", ScreenGui)
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 280)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -90, 0.4, 0)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
Instance.new("UICorner", MainFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

-- Barra de Título (Arrastrable)
local TitleBar = Instance.new("TextButton", MainFrame)
TitleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
TitleBar.Text = "  TRI-MENU V6.1"
TitleBar.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
TitleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 35)
TitleBar.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
TitleBar.TextSize = 12
TitleBar.AutoButtonColor = false
TitleBar.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
Instance.new("UICorner", TitleBar)

local MiniBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", TitleBar)
MiniBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, 25)
MiniBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 5)
MiniBtn.Text = "-"
MiniBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 55)
MiniBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Instance.new("UICorner", MiniBtn)

-- Lógica de Arrastre
local dragging, dragStart, startPos
TitleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position
        local releaseConnection
        releaseConnection = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(endInput)
            if endInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or endInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = false
                releaseConnection:Disconnect()
            end
        end)
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)

-- --- BARRA DE PESTAÑAS (AJUSTADA A 2) ---
local TabBar = Instance.new("Frame", MainFrame)
TabBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
TabBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 35)
TabBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30)
TabBar.BorderSizePixel = 0

local function CreateTabBtn(txt, pos)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton", TabBar)
    b.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0) -- 50% de ancho cada una
    b.Position = UDim2.new(pos, 0, 0, 0)
    b.Text = txt
    b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 40)
    b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    b.TextSize = 10
    b.BorderSizePixel = 0
    return b
end

local btnTab1 = CreateTabBtn("WALK", 0)
local btnTab2 = CreateTabBtn("PATH", 0.5)

-- Contenedores de Pestañas
local Pages = Instance.new("Frame", MainFrame)
Pages.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -65)
Pages.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 65)
Pages.BackgroundTransparency = 1

local function CreatePage()
    local p = Instance.new("Frame", Pages)
    p.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    p.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    p.Visible = false
    local l = Instance.new("UIListLayout", p)
    l.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
    l.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
    Instance.new("UIPadding", p).PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10)
    return p
end

local pageWalk = CreatePage()
local pagePath = CreatePage()

local function ShowPage(page)
    pageWalk.Visible = false; pagePath.Visible = false
    page.Visible = true
end
ShowPage(pageWalk)

btnTab1.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() ShowPage(pageWalk) end)
btnTab2.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() ShowPage(pagePath) end)

-- --- COMPONENTES UI REUTILIZABLES ---
local function UI_Button(txt, col, parent)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton", parent)
    b.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 32)
    b.Text = txt
    b.BackgroundColor3 = col
    b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    b.TextSize = 10
    Instance.new("UICorner", b)
    return b
end

local function UI_Input(ph, parent)
    local i = Instance.new("TextBox", parent)
    i.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 30)
    i.PlaceholderText = ph
    i.Text = ""
    i.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 45)
    i.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    i.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    i.TextSize = 11
    Instance.new("UICorner", i)
    return i

-- --- 1. LÓGICA AIR WALK ---
local btnAW_Toggle = UI_Button("ESTADO: OFF", Color3.fromRGB(150, 50, 50), pageWalk)
UI_Button("↑ SUBIR (Q)", Color3.fromRGB(45, 130, 180), pageWalk).MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Estado.AlturaDeseada += 3 end)
UI_Button("↓ BAJAR (E)", Color3.fromRGB(120, 60, 150), pageWalk).MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Estado.AlturaDeseada -= 3 end)
UI_Button("LIMPIAR", Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80), pageWalk).MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Folders.AirWalk:ClearAllChildren() end)

btnAW_Toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Estado.AirWalk = not Estado.AirWalk
    btnAW_Toggle.Text = Estado.AirWalk and "ESTADO: ON" or "ESTADO: OFF"
    btnAW_Toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Estado.AirWalk and Color3.fromRGB(50, 150, 80) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 50, 50)
    if Estado.AirWalk and Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        Estado.AlturaDeseada = Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position.Y - 3.2
    else
        Folders.AirWalk:ClearAllChildren()
    end
end)

-- --- 2. LÓGICA PATH BUILDER ---
local inPathLargo = UI_Input("Largo del Camino", pagePath)
local inPathAncho = UI_Input("Ancho del Camino", pagePath)
UI_Button("GENERAR CAMINO", Color3.fromRGB(100, 50, 150), pagePath).MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local root = Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end
    local p = Instance.new("Part", Folders.Path)
    local l, a = tonumber(inPathLargo.Text) or 100, tonumber(inPathAncho.Text) or 15
    p.Size = Vector3.new(a, 1, l); p.Anchored = true; p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 100, 255)
    p.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -3.2, -l/2)
end)
UI_Button("BORRAR CAMINOS", Color3.fromRGB(150, 50, 50), pagePath).MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Folders.Path:ClearAllChildren() end)

-- --- BUCLE PRINCIPAL (AIR WALK) ---
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not Estado.AirWalk then return end
    local root = Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end
    local pos = root.Position
    if not Estado.UltimaPlataforma or (Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Z) - Vector2.new(Estado.UltimaPlataforma.Position.X, Estado.UltimaPlataforma.Position.Z)).Magnitude > 2.5 then
        if Estado.UltimaPlataforma then 
            local old = Estado.UltimaPlataforma
            TweenService:Create(old, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {Transparency = 1, Size = Vector3.new(0,0,0)}):Play()
            game.Debris:AddItem(old, 0.5)
        end
        local p = Instance.new("Part", Folders.AirWalk)
        p.Size = Vector3.new(6, 0.6, 6); p.Anchored = true; p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255); p.Transparency = 0.4
        p.Position = Vector3.new(pos.X, Estado.AlturaDeseada, pos.Z)
        Estado.UltimaPlataforma = p
    end
end)

-- Minimizar
local Minimizado = false
MiniBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Minimizado = not Minimizado
    TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {Size = Minimizado and UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 35) or UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 280)}):Play()
    MiniBtn.Text = Minimizado and "+" or "-"
    Pages.Visible = not Minimizado
    TabBar.Visible = not Minimizado
end)

-- Teclas rápidas
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
    if gpe then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then Estado.AlturaDeseada += 3
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then Estado.AlturaDeseada -= 3 end
end)

--[[
    AIR-WALK V5.2: CAMINO PERMANENTE + LIMPIEZA (SIN RESET)
--]]

local CONFIG = {
    Dimensiones = { Tamano = Vector3.new(6, 0.6, 6) },
    Propiedades = {
        Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
        Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255),
        TransparenciaInicial = 0.5,
    },
    AjusteY = 3.2
}

local Player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local SistemaActivo = false
local Minimizado = false
local AlturaDeseada = 0
local ultimaPlataforma = nil
local Character, Root

local Folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("AirWalk_Folder") or Instance.new("Folder", workspace)
Folder.Name = "AirWalk_Folder"

local function ActualizarReferencias()
    Character = Player.Character or Player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    Root = Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end
ActualizarReferencias()
Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(ActualizarReferencias)

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", Player.PlayerGui)
ScreenGui.Name = "AirWalk_Fixed"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true

local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame", ScreenGui)
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 220) -- Tamaño reducido al quitar un botón
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -80, 0.5, -110)

TitleBar.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
TitleBar.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
TitleBar.TextSize = 12
TitleBar.AutoButtonColor = false
Instance.new("UICorner", TitleBar)

local MiniBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", TitleBar)
MiniBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30)
MiniBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 2)
MiniBtn.Text = "-"
MiniBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
MiniBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
MiniBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Instance.new("UICorner", MiniBtn)

-- --- LÓGICA DE ARRASTRAR (FIJADA) ---
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
local function update(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
end

TitleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
        end)
    end
end)

TitleBar.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and input == dragInput then update(input) end
end)

-- --- BOTONES ---

ButtonContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -35)
ButtonContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 35)
ButtonContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1

List.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
List.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
Instance.new("UIPadding", ButtonContainer).PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10)

local function crearBoton(texto, color)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", ButtonContainer)
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 35) -- Un poco más altos para llenar mejor el espacio
    btn.Text = texto
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = color
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    btn.TextSize = 11
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn)
    return btn
end

local btnToggle = crearBoton("ESTADO: OFF", Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50))
local btnSubir  = crearBoton("↑ SUBIR (Q)", Color3.fromRGB(40, 120, 180))
local btnBajar  = crearBoton("↓ BAJAR (E)", Color3.fromRGB(130, 60, 160))
local btnClear  = crearBoton("LIMPIAR CAMINO", Color3.fromRGB(200, 0, 0))

-- Minimizar
MiniBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Minimizado = not Minimizado
    local targetSize = Minimizado and UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 35) or UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 220)
    MiniBtn.Text = Minimizado and "+" or "-"
    TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {Size = targetSize}):Play()
end)

-- Lógica de Funciones
btnToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    SistemaActivo = not SistemaActivo
    btnToggle.Text = SistemaActivo and "ESTADO: ON" or "ESTADO: OFF"
    btnToggle.BackgroundColor3 = SistemaActivo and Color3.fromRGB(40, 180, 100) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)
    if SistemaActivo then AlturaDeseada = Root.Position.Y - CONFIG.AjusteY end
end)

btnSubir.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() AlturaDeseada = AlturaDeseada + 3 end)
btnBajar.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() AlturaDeseada = AlturaDeseada - 3 end)

btnClear.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Folder:ClearAllChildren()
    ultimaPlataforma = nil
end)

-- Atajos
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(i, gpe)
    if gpe then return end
    if i.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then AlturaDeseada = AlturaDeseada + 3
    elseif i.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then AlturaDeseada = AlturaDeseada - 3 end
end)

-- Bucle de construcción
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not SistemaActivo or not Root then return end
    local pos = Root.Position
    local platformPos = Vector3.new(pos.X, AlturaDeseada, pos.Z)
    
    if not ultimaPlataforma or (Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Z) - Vector2.new(ultimaPlataforma.Position.X, ultimaPlataforma.Position.Z)).Magnitude > 3 then
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        p.Size = CONFIG.Dimensiones.Tamano
        p.Position = platformPos
        p.Anchored = true
        p.Material = CONFIG.Propiedades.Material
        p.Color = CONFIG.Propiedades.Color
        p.Transparency = CONFIG.Propiedades.TransparenciaInicial
        p.Parent = Folder
        ultimaPlataforma = p
    end
end)

    end

    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then

-- ============================================================
-- 4. FUNÇÃO PARA ENCONTRAR O FINAL DA FASE
-- ============================================================

local function findEndOfMap()
    print("🔍 Procurando final da fase...")
    
    -- Diferentes métodos para encontrar o final
    local endPositions = {}
    
    -- Método 1: Procurar por partes com nomes comuns
    local commonEndNames = {
        "End", "Finish", "Final", "Win", "Victory", 
        "Goal", "Checkpoint", "Flag", "Platform",
        "Top", "Summit", "Peak", "Winner"
    }
    
    for _, name in ipairs(commonEndNames) do
        for _, obj in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") and string.find(obj.Name:lower(), name:lower()) then
                table.insert(endPositions, obj.Position)
                print("✅ Encontrado: " .. obj.Name .. " em " .. tostring(obj.Position))
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Método 2: Procurar pela parte mais alta do mapa
    local highestPart = nil
    local highestY = -math.huge
    
    for _, obj in pairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") or obj:IsA("BasePart") then
            local position = obj:GetPivot().Position
            if position.Y > highestY then
                highestY = position.Y
                highestPart = position
            end
        end
    end
    
    if highestPart then
        table.insert(endPositions, highestPart)
        print("✅ Ponto mais alto: Y = " .. highestY)
    end
    
    -- Método 3: Procurar por plataformas especiais
    for _, obj in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
            -- Plataformas grandes (provavelmente finais)
            if obj.Size.X > 20 and obj.Size.Z > 20 then
                table.insert(endPositions, obj.Position)
            end
            
            -- Partes coloridas (vermelho, verde, dourado)
            if obj.BrickColor == BrickColor.new("Bright red") or
               obj.BrickColor == BrickColor.new("Bright green") or
               obj.BrickColor == BrickColor.new("Bright yellow") then
                table.insert(endPositions, obj.Position)
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Escolher a melhor posição
    if #endPositions > 0 then
        -- Priorizar posições altas
        table.sort(endPositions, function(a, b)
            return a.Y > b.Y
        end)
        
        local bestPosition = endPositions[1] + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0) -- 5 unidades acima
        print("🎯 Melhor posição encontrada: " .. tostring(bestPosition))
        return bestPosition
    end
    
    -- Método 4: Se não encontrou, usar posição fixa alta
    print("⚠️ Nenhum final encontrado, usando posição padrão")
    return Vector3.new(0, 500, 0) -- Posição alta padrão
end

-- ============================================================
-- 5. FUNÇÃO DE TELEPORTE PARA O FINAL
-- ============================================================

local function teleportToEnd()
    if isTeleporting then return end
    isTeleporting = true
    
    print("🚀 Iniciando teleporte para o final...")
    teleportButton.Text = "⏳ TELEPORTANDO..."
    teleportButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 0)
    statusLabel.Text = "🔍 Localizando final da fase..."
    
    -- Obter personagem

        character = player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    end
    
    -- Garantir que o personagem existe
    local humanoidRootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    
    -- Encontrar posição final
    local endPosition = findEndOfMap()
    
    -- Animar antes do teleporte

    -- Efeito visual (opcional)

    end
    
    -- Realizar teleporte
    if humanoidRootPart then
        -- Teleportar para o final

        print("✅ Teleportado para: " .. tostring(endPosition))
        
        -- Garantir que não caia
        task.wait(0.1)
        humanoid.PlatformStand = false
        
        statusLabel.Text = "✅ Teleportado com sucesso!"
    end
    
    -- Restaurar botão
    task.wait(1)
    teleportButton.Text = "🚀 TELEPORTAR PARA O FINAL"
    teleportButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 80)
    isTeleporting = false
    
    print("✅ Teleporte concluído!")
end

-- ============================================================
-- 6. FUNCIONALIDADE DE MINIMIZAR
-- ============================================================

local function toggleMinimize()
    isMinimized = not isMinimized
    
    if isMinimized then
        -- Minimizar: mostrar apenas o título
        local tween = TweenService:Create(mainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 380, 0, 40)
        })
        tween:Play()
        
        minimizeButton.Text = "📂 MAXIMIZAR"
        title.Text = "⚡ TELEPORT [MIN] ⚡"
        
        -- Esconder conteúdo
        teleportButton.Visible = false
        minimizeButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 0)
        minimizeButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 40)

        })

    end

local function getHum() 
    local c = getChar() 
    return c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
